enchantments.tooltip: Lesser Monstrous Humanoid Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Monstrous Humanoids, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +1 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 1 to 6 points of damage against the foe.
